notes: appRegistryRow: the KiroCrew federated app-registry row for the FloofyCrew Loader — the generated `loader-app` branch of the FloofyCrew repository holds app/floofycrew and its own app-registry.json (the public twin of the internal data package); the release workflow pins a copy to `loader-app-<tag>`. registriesSource: the row `floofy registry defaults` writes to ~/.kiro/crew/floofy/registries.json for the public mod registry, with the public key the public edition adapter pins (editions/public/floofy_edition_public/registry.json, key 31ddb18e6ffafef2). The GitHub organisation `floofycrew` is the placeholder of the 7.5 owner item: change it here and in the adapter together.
